boundary.description: From the confluence of River Mersey and Manchester Ship Canal, NE along Manchester Ship Canal to and along W border of United Utilities Wastewater Treatment Plant. Then S by Woodhouse, E by Davy Hulme Road, Bowers Avenue, Moorside Road, Brook Road, Flixton Road, Penny Bridge Lane and by a beeline S to and W along Church Road to 253 Church Road (near bus stop ID MANJPADG) and by a beeline S to River Mersey. Then by River Mersey to its confluence with Manchester Ship Canal.
